author: Huam
body:
• Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed) Gimq | Atm its Pranos.
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned Ban Evasion.
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server I wouldn't say I have to get unbanned, but if I do it would be amazing.
  • Hi, my name is Nick and I really want to join this server again its an amazing server to play on but sadly I got banned a while ago and I was hoping to get unbanned since I served quite a long time as to my knowledge, I really miss this server as you can say, and I can't wait to get unbanned.
  • I hope you would understand me, and seeing howmuch this server is growing I would love to experience it myself.
